title: request-allowlist input
description: Request an IP address or CIDR be added to the nethesis-insights allowlist

examples.reason: False positive: this is our office egress IP

cidr.title: cidr
cidr.description: A bare address or CIDR. The server normalises a bare address to /32 or /128 and rejects a prefix wider than /24 (IPv4) or /48 (IPv6).

reason.title: reason
reason.description: Free text explaining why this address should be allowlisted
